source_snapshot.criteria: All GPU PCIe links must train to maximum supported generation at x16 with no correctable or uncorrectable errors.

source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; NVIDIA PCIe/GPU toolchain plus operator-controlled cold DC/S5 cycling and per-iteration link/GPU/log evidence.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly requires operator participation, but calling the case cold DC (S5) leaves whether standby rails remain powered unresolved and does not define dwell/readiness or SY.1 artifact equivalence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds graceful S5 entry, approved DC-control boundary, per-iteration shutdown/boot evidence, stable topology, first-fault preservation and owner recovery.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-01/03 require method-purpose fit; ED-07/08 require per-cycle evidence; ED-11/12 prohibit continuation or retry after first fault; ED-36/38 bind verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify repeatable GPU enumeration and maximum-generation x16 PCIe retraining with zero correctable or uncorrectable errors after each of 25 cold DC or S5 transitions, or via an explicitly equivalent and traceable SY.1 checkpoint.
original_method: Define whether the required boundary is graceful S5 with auxiliary power retained or controlled removal/restoration of a named DC rail, and do not substitute AC loss; map all GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF and root-port/switch maximum links; pin shutdown, power-state proof, dwell, start and boot/readiness deadlines; supervise and number 25 transitions; after each boot capture GPU inventory, link/AER and platform evidence; stop on the first failed transition, missing device, downtrained link or new error and retain state for recovery.
manual_activity: An authorized operator drains the host, verifies each S5 or named DC transition and return, observes management and host readiness, and owns failed shutdown/boot recovery.
required_inputs: Approved NVIDIA PCIe/GPU qualification and evidence-collection toolchain
GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF to root-port/switch topology with per-link maximum generation and x16 expectation
Authoritative cold-DC definition: graceful S5 and retained rails or named DC-rail removal, with state proof and dwell/start/ready timing
SY.1 artifact mapping, maintenance approval, per-cycle acceptance, first-fault stop and recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated drained SUT with console/BMC and approved S5 or DC control
Verify the intended host and power boundary; do not remove AC or unrelated DC domains as an implicit substitute
Preserve pre-run and first-fault logs and counters
Stop on shutdown timeout, unexpected rail state, boot timeout, missing GPU, downtrained link, any new correctable/uncorrectable error, abnormal power/thermal state or lost recovery access
No automatic retry or unsupervised cycle loop
agent_execution_scope: Validate exact power-state boundary, topology, maximum-link matrix, timing, readiness, SY.1 traceability and recovery
Automate shutdown/readiness and evidence capture while requiring approved operator oversight for power actions
Compare every GPU/link against the explicit oracle after each of 25 returns
Do not reinterpret S5 as AC loss, clear logs, infer missing cycles, continue after failure, retry automatically or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Decide S5 versus named DC-rail semantics and approve entry/exit/state-proof timing and 25-cycle accounting
Approve topology, maximum-link and zero-error criteria plus SY.1 equivalence and evidence
Review every iteration and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Post-cycle lspci and nvidia-smi checks fit the acceptance, but the source still needs an authoritative DC/S5 state boundary, control primitive, timing and topology-specific oracle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Perform exactly 25 owner-defined cold-DC/S5 transitions under operator supervision, prove each entry and exit state, and collect the complete GPU/link/error/platform set before another transition.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Twenty-five cold DC cycles, SY.1 subset relationship, maximum supported generation x16, zero correctable/uncorrectable errors, no bundle, and 5/720-minute allocation remain; power-state semantics are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH 25-CYCLE COLD DC OR S5 GPU PCIE RETRAIN QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: First establish the exact retained-versus-removed power domains, then use a numbered state-transition ledger that accepts each cycle only after verified S5/DC entry, restart, complete GPU enumeration and clean maximum-link training.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a non-ambiguous power boundary, state proof, timing, stable link oracle, per-cycle artifacts, first-fault retention and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final snapshot or generic SY.1 PASS can hide failed S5 entry, unintended AC cycling, retained state, intermittent missing GPUs, downtraining or corrected errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated shutdown and DC-state transition destroys runtime state and can expose firmware/power sequencing faults; ambiguous controls could exercise the wrong power domain.

project_override_considerations: SY.1 can cover this row only if its artifacts demonstrate the exact approved cold-DC/S5 boundary and all 25 per-cycle GPU/link/error checks. Full AC loss and warm reboot are different state transitions and are not interchangeable.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, tool versions, target identity and SY.1 traceability
Approved S5/DC power-domain definition and control, GPU topology and maximum-generation x16 baseline
Twenty-five numbered shutdown/state-proof/dwell/start/boot/readiness records with operator timestamps
For every cycle: complete GPU inventory, lspci LnkSta/capabilities/AER, nvidia-smi, dmesg/journal, BMC/SEL, power-state and thermal/health evidence
First-fault/recovery evidence or stable post-cycle-25 state
Engineer PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED decision

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, Criteria and reviews consistently address 25 cold DC/S5 recovery cycles. The precise power-domain boundary and SY.1 equivalence are unresolved execution definitions, not a competing test purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The power-state recovery and PCIe acceptance are clear enough to review. Exact S5/DC semantics, tooling and topology can be supplied, so the case is pending rather than irreducibly blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2146 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00023-V003: define whether cold DC means graceful S5 with auxiliary rails retained or removal/restoration of named DC rails; approve the control/state proof, dwell/start/boot/readiness timing, 25-cycle accounting, GPU UUID/slot/BDF-to-root-port/switch maximum-generation x16 matrix, SY.1 equivalence, zero-error interpretation, first-fault aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents AC, S5 and DC-rail transitions from being conflated and makes all 25 device/link recoveries independently traceable.
independent_technical_reasoning: S5 normally retains platform standby power, whereas removal of a DC domain can reset additional devices and sequencing logic; therefore the phrase cold DC is not sufficiently precise for execution. The chosen boundary must be observable on every iteration. Since transient enumeration and corrected-error failures can be lost after the next shutdown, the complete acceptance set is captured before another cycle and the first failure terminates the run.
